title: Add string resource info_dialog_title
description: Add the string resource used to localize "About Goblin Loot Engine".
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains <string name="info_dialog_title">About Goblin Loot Engine</string>
start_anchor: <string name="info_developer_options_body">Down at the bottom of Settings is a locked "Developer Options" section — it holds Delete All Data and JSON backup/restore, all of which can overwrite or erase your quests for good. Press and hold its header to unlock it; you\'ll be asked to confirm before it opens. It re-locks the next time you open Settings, so a stray tap can\'t land on Delete All Data by accident.</string>
